settings.title: Settings
settings.odometerReminderWeekdayInfo: On that day, from the reminder time, we notify you once about active vehicles with no odometer reading for 7 days or more. Choose «Don't remind me» to turn it off.
settings.reminderHourHint: We will notify you from this time in your time zone.
settings.reminderHourInfo: The app checks reminders every hour on the hour. Each reminder is sent only once, at the first check from this time in your time zone. If the server was off at that time, it arrives at the next check that same day.

validation.minLength_one: Must be at least {{count}} character long.
validation.minLength_other: Must be at least {{count}} characters long.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.newDescription: Only make and model are required. You can fill in the rest later.

empty.all: You haven't added any vehicle yet.

vehicles.manageDescription: Archive vehicles you no longer use or mark them as sold: their history is kept.

form.currentOdometerHint: It will be saved as the first reading, dated today.
form.purchaseDescription: Used to work out the cost of ownership and for the sale report.

actions.markSoldDescription: The vehicle will leave your garage, but you'll keep its whole history.
actions.deleteDescription: The vehicle, its photo and all its mileage readings will be erased. This can't be undone. If you just want to hide it, archive it.

photo.invalid: That image couldn't be used. Try a smaller JPG, PNG or WebP.

odometer.pageDescription: Write down what each vehicle's odometer shows. Ikrive will remind you every week so mileage-based alerts stay accurate.
odometer.title: Mileage
odometer.description: Every reading feeds the alerts and the statistics.

errors.backwards: The mileage can't be lower than an earlier reading or higher than a later one.
errors.future: The date can't be in the future.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.deleteDescription: The record and its mileage reading will be erased. This can't be undone.

errors.odometerConflict: The mileage doesn't fit the vehicle's readings: it can't be lower than an earlier one or higher than a later one.
errors.future: The date can't be in the future.

attachments.title: Invoices
attachments.empty: This maintenance has no invoices yet.
attachments.help: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP · max. {{max}} MB
attachments.retryHint: Some invoices weren't uploaded. You can upload them again from the maintenance invoices.
attachments.deleteDescription: The invoice file will be erased. This can't be undone.

errors.type: “{{name}}” isn't a supported type: only PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP.
errors.size: “{{name}}” is larger than the {{max}} MB limit.
errors.sizeUnknownLimit: “{{name}}” is larger than the allowed size.

schedules.title: Upcoming maintenance
schedules.empty: No maintenance schedules yet. Add one to know when each service is due.
schedules.deleteDescription: The schedule will be erased. Linked maintenance records are kept but will no longer be tied to it.
schedules.noData: Not enough data to work out when it's due
schedules.lastDoneHelp: If you leave it blank, it counts from the vehicle's purchase.

errors.intervalRequired: Enter an interval in months or in {{unit}}

notificationChannels.title: Notification channels
notificationChannels.description: Get your reminders outside the app too: ntfy, Gotify, Apprise or your own webhook.
notificationChannels.empty: No channels yet. For now, reminders only show up in the app's bell.
notificationChannels.tokenKeep: A token is stored. Leave it blank to keep it.
notificationChannels.deleteDescription: You will stop getting reminders through this channel. In-app notifications are not affected.

errors.urlCredentials: Do not put a username or password in the URL: use the token field.
